documents.FBIS_3: Hurricane Mitch battered Central America with torrential rains and destructive mudslides. Relief workers struggled to reach isolated mountain communities cut off by collapsed bridges.
documents.FBIS_4: In Honduras and Nicaragua, emergency officials declared a state of catastrophe. The United Nations appealed for global humanitarian aid to provide clean water and medical supplies.
documents.APW_2: International cargo planes delivered food rations and temporary shelters. Governments around the world pledged millions in emergency disaster relief funds.

reference_summaries: Hurricane Mitch triggered catastrophic flooding and mudslides across Honduras and Nicaragua. The disaster prompted international emergency rescue operations and United Nations aid appeals.
